notes.title: Mages of Osmea v1.1.0
notes.content:
The first update for Mages of Osmea has been released!


Updated networking library. 
More robust handling of corner cases of networking events, specifically respawning and projectile destructions.
Other minor fixes such as fixing showing tooltips for level locked cosmetic items.
Reduce speed and health of the Bull miniboss by 10%. This miniboss was much stronger compared to the other types.
